question: How many customers do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers

question: Total revenue in 2024
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND year(o.order_date) = 2024

question: Revenue by product category
sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Top 5 customers by revenue
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 5

question: Monthly number of completed orders in 2023
sql: SELECT month(order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND year(order_date) = 2023 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Average order value by channel
sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(AVG(t.order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct / 100)) AS order_value FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t ON t.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

question: How many orders were cancelled per year?
sql: SELECT year(order_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: Which 3 products had the most units sold?
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id LIMIT 3

question: Number of customers by segment
sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY segment ORDER BY customers DESC

question: Revenue by customer country, top 5
sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: What share of web sessions converted, by device?
sql: SELECT device, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN converted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct FROM web_sessions GROUP BY device ORDER BY conversion_rate_pct DESC

question: Average ticket resolution time in hours by priority
sql: SELECT priority, ROUND(AVG(epoch(resolved_at - opened_at)) / 3600, 2) AS avg_resolution_hours FROM support_tickets WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY priority ORDER BY avg_resolution_hours

question: Which suppliers supply the most products?
sql: SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, COUNT(*) AS products FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name ORDER BY products DESC, s.supplier_id LIMIT 5

question: Total marketing budget by channel
sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(budget), 2) AS total_budget FROM marketing_campaigns GROUP BY channel ORDER BY total_budget DESC

question: How many distinct customers placed a completed order in 2024?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND year(order_date) = 2024

question: Total revenue by year
sql: SELECT year(o.order_date) AS year, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
